tables.name: instance_metadata
tables.purpose: stable technical identity of the canonical SOMA data instance
rules: exactly one row is created by the initial accepted migration
data_instance_id is an opaque lowercase UUIDv4 technical identity
restore preserves the restored instance identity; creating a new empty instance allocates a new identity
runtime registry reads this identity after persistence verification and never derives it from path/port/PID

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.mutation: insert only through migration runner; accepted rows are never edited/deleted by ordinary runtime

tables.name: command_receipts
tables.purpose: committed-command idempotency identity and minimal result reference
rules: insert in same authoritative transaction as accepted mutation/audit
same command_id + same command_type + same request_hash is a replay candidate and never authorizes owner re-execution
same command_id with different command_type or request_hash is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
failed/rolled-back command creates no committed receipt
receipts created before migration 5 are preserved byte-for-byte and may lack an exact replay-result companion row

tables.name: command_receipt_results
tables.purpose: exact immutable committed response snapshot used for replay without consulting mutable domain state
columns: command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: every command newly committed after migration 5 records exactly one companion row in the same UnitOfWork as its receipt and accepted result
response_json is strict canonical UTF-8 JSON for the exact owning-command response, including semantic NO_CHANGE
response_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 over the exact canonical response_json UTF-8 bytes
replay validates response schema/version/canonical hash before returning it and does not call command prepare, owner repositories, projection readers or current-state reconstruction
migration 5 never backfills a response by reading mutable domain state
a legacy receipt without a provably exact response returns IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE rather than rerunning or fabricating a response
protection: INSERT uses plain INSERT; duplicate command_id is an integrity failure; no INSERT OR IGNORE/REPLACE

tables.name: audit_events
columns: command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
protection: INSERT uses plain INSERT; duplicate audit_event_id is an integrity failure; no INSERT OR IGNORE/REPLACE

tables.name: audit_event_results
tables.purpose: immutable references from one audit event to resulting lifecycle/domain events without copying event bodies
columns: audit_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES audit_events(audit_event_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: durable_jobs
tables.purpose: restart-safe current job coordination; never domain lifecycle authority
columns: state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','waiting_review','retry_wait','completed','failed','cancelled'))
updated_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at_utc >= created_at_utc)
attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt_count >= 0)
checkpoint_json TEXT CHECK(checkpoint_json IS NULL OR json_valid(checkpoint_json))
rules: state=running requires claimed_run_id and claim_started_at_utc; non-running states clear them
job payload/checkpoint contracts are named by job_type + contract_version
no credentials/unrestricted communication bodies/whole provider payloads
job state cannot substitute for domain acceptance state

tables.name: job_attempts
tables.purpose: append-style history of completed/failed/cancelled/interrupted executions of a durable job
columns: job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_jobs(job_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
finished_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(finished_at_utc >= started_at_utc)
outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('completed','failed','cancelled','interrupted'))
rules: one row is inserted only when an attempt reaches a terminal/interrupted result
startup recovery inserts interrupted history for stale prior-run claims before requeue/retry disposition
attempt history never becomes domain lifecycle evidence

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_target ON audit_events(target_type, target_id, recorded_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_state_due ON durable_jobs(state, next_attempt_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_type_state ON durable_jobs(job_type, state)
schema_rules: all LLD-01 foundation tables SHALL use SQLite STRICT table mode
foreign-key child columns must have effective leading-prefix indexes unless an explicit measured exception exists
command_receipt_results.command_id needs no redundant FK index because its PRIMARY KEY is the exact leading child key
do not create a redundant index when an existing PRIMARY KEY/UNIQUE index already satisfies the same effective leading-prefix path
domain tables are added only by their owning LLD/migrations
runtime registry and diagnostics are external technical state, not SQLite tables
